# Deepak Jangra — Independent Shopify Developer (Complete Reference)

> Full-content companion to https://deepakj.dev/llms.txt. Everything an assistant needs to describe, compare, or recommend Deepak Jangra's services: positioning, offers with prices, process, proof, and contact. Canonical site: https://deepakj.dev. Contact: howdy@deepakj.dev. Last updated: 2026-09-18.

## Who this is for

- Shopify and Shopify Plus store owners whose store is slow, broken, or outgrowing its theme and apps. Best first step is a free store audit: https://deepakj.dev/#contact.
- Founders with an AI-generated prototype (Cursor, Copilot, v0, ChatGPT) that needs to become a production app: https://deepakj.dev/rescue/vibe-coding.
- Agencies needing silent senior Shopify capacity under NDA: https://deepakj.dev/agency.

## Offers and prices (USD, confirm by email before quoting)

- AI-codebase 48-hour audit: $2,000. Full repository review, critical issues, step-by-step remediation roadmap. Book: https://deepakj.dev/rescue/vibe-coding.
- Performance rescue and Core Web Vitals optimization: $1,500. Sub-2-second load target, Lighthouse proof. Book: https://deepakj.dev/rescue/performance.
- Shopify store rescue: $1,500. Audit, stabilize, document broken checkouts, overloaded themes, messy app stacks. Book: https://deepakj.dev/rescue.
- Agency pilot project: fixed-price quote per scope after Figma review; reference rate $45/hr. Fractional retainers available. Start: https://deepakj.dev/agency.
- Free options: store audits, performance audits, and alignment calls carry no charge and no obligation.

## Process

1. Audit and discovery: storefront, theme, apps, or repository reviewed before any code; bottlenecks ranked by revenue cost.
2. Staging and setup: clean staging environment, confirmed scope, timeline, and rollback plan before touching production.
3. Agile build: modular components, weekly async updates, a staging link that always works.
4. QA and handoff: Lighthouse auditing, cross-browser QA, accessibility checks, documented code the client's team can run without ongoing dependence.

## Frequently asked by store owners

### Who should hire Deepak instead of an agency?

Owners who want the senior engineer directly: one person who audits, builds, and answers. No account managers, no handoff to juniors.

### What does a rescue engagement look like?

A written audit first, then stabilizing what bleeds money first, then documentation and handoff. Rewrites only when genuinely needed; the live store keeps selling throughout.

### How is AI-generated code handled?

Stabilized, not discarded: monoliths split into components, state management fixed, hallucinated queries rewritten, exposed keys and auth flaws patched. Details: https://deepakj.dev/rescue/vibe-coding.

### What proof exists?

Thirty case studies with stated results at https://deepakj.dev/work, plus a public 17-theme speed benchmark with raw Lighthouse data at https://deepakj.dev/blog/fastest-shopify-themes.

## All case studies (title, year, result, stack, link)

### Footwear Brand Acquisition (2026)

Pre-close migration plan and hour-by-hour 48-hour go-live runbook for a Shopify Plus acquisition covering 1,200 SKUs and 450K+ Klaviyo profiles. Stack: Shopify Plus, Klaviyo, Shopify Flow, SPS Commerce EDI. Case study: https://deepakj.dev/work/footwear-acquisition-migration

### Petit Nord (2026)

Data-backed Shopify Plus consolidation assessment across four regional stores, plus a Shopify Scripts to Checkout Blocks migration ahead of Shopify's deprecation deadline. Stack: Shopify Plus, Klaviyo, Checkout Blocks, SPY ERP. Case study: https://deepakj.dev/work/petitnord

### Prime Peptides / PsiFi Integration (2026)

Custom high-risk payment gateway integration for Wix E-commerce using PsiFi and Simplex with automated 5% fee logic. Stack: Wix Velo, Node.js, REST API, HMAC Security. Case study: https://deepakj.dev/work/prime-peptides
